newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan says convention centre attracts interest.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan says convention centre attracts interest.

text.p: Pakistan's Privatisation Commission said four foreign companies had shown interest in acquiring a state-owned convention centre in Islamabad.
It named them as Malaysia's Actacorp Holdings Berhard, South Korea's Daewoo Corporation, Galadari Brothers of the United Arab Emirates and JAS Consulting Inc of the United States.

The statement said the successful bidder would be allowed to develop land adjacent to the 2,000-seat convention centre for commercial purposes, such as a five-star hotel, a shopping mall or recreational facilities.
The silver-domed convention centre, built on 4.13 acres (1.652 hectares) for an Islamic summit conference held in March, is within a total project area of 30 acres (12 hectares).
